topic: Draymond Green's teammate gets into a basketball fight and mimics his dirty play style, making Draymond proud.

hook.first_frame: Close-up of Draymond Green on the court during a game.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: Draymond Green is known for his dirty plays and antics on the court,

shots.shows: Draymond Green tangling with opposing players on court
Draymond Green stepping over a player on court
Basketball players fighting under the basket
Pat Spencer headbutting Sengun during a scuffle
Draymond Green watching from the bench and smiling proudly

ending.last_frame: Draymond Green smiling and clapping on the bench.

script: Draymond Green is known for his dirty plays and antics on the court, but on the Warriors no one else really acts like that. So when the rockets started getting to a fight with them, everyone was surprised when Pat Spencer fought back and headbutted Sengun. And it didn't end there as Trayce Jackson-Davis would get involved, backing up his teammate. But that's when the cameras would perfectly cut to a proud-looking Draymond!
what_makes_it_work: Engaging narrative arc from a player's reputation to a teammate mimicking it
Surprising escalation of the basketball fight
Humorous and satisfying payoff reaction shot of Draymond Green smiling proudly
